newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX eases on ACCESS.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX eases on ACCESS.

text.p: April Brent crude futures were traded slightly firmer in late trading on Monday in continued range trading.
April on SIMEX was last traded at $19.88 per barrel, up two cents from London, but in very quiet trading.
NYMEX April crude was last traded at $21.15 per barrel, down 13 cents from New York as prices eased after Friday's rally.
Both New York and London firmed on Friday in a continued rebound from last week's lows.
Brokers said they expected prices to range trade between $19 and $20.00 but medium term were not convinced the downtrend was over.
Front-month Brent needed to close above $20.00 to indicate that some fresh buying might be coming into the market.
The rebound was built on technical chart indications rather than fresh buying and there were few fundamental factors to support prices.
The U.S. gasoline season would not kick off for more than a month, leaving the market focusing on technicals.
